title: Transform with map
description: Using Array#map, build a new array with every element doubled.
hint: map yields each element to the block and collects the block's return values: arr.map { |x| x * 2 }

payload.prompt: Using Array#map, build a new array with every element doubled.

title: Filter with select
description: Using Array#select, keep only the even numbers.
hint: The &:method shorthand turns a symbol into a block: arr.select(&:even?)

payload.prompt: Using Array#select, keep only the even numbers.

title: Safe nested lookup with dig
description: Using Hash#dig, read the nested value at :user, then :name — returning nil instead of raising when a key is missing.
hint: dig takes one key per nesting level: h.dig(:user, :name)

payload.prompt: Using Hash#dig, read the nested value at :user, then :name.

title: Sum it all up
description: Sum every element of the array — any idiomatic way counts.
hint: reduce(:+) folds the array through +; Array#sum and inject(:+) say the same thing

payload.prompt: Sum every element of the array.

title: Shout every name
description: Using map with the &:symbol shorthand, upcase every name in the array.

payload.prompt: Using map with the &:symbol shorthand, upcase every name.
